goal: Add a validated advisory Codex capability brief to the reviewed Provider generation context and prove the path on one small child project without creating a second generation or delivery route.
acceptance_criteria: A small child project is attempted through the reviewed Provider route and its generated tests plus CLI behavior are evaluated without manual source edits.
Only a bounded projection reaches the existing Provider planning and component contexts, and the brief hash binds checkpoint reuse.
Tampered authority, changed resume identity, and oversized projections fail before Provider candidate generation.
The change preserves Provider output validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public_delivery_gate, and delivery_manifest.json.
The formal CLI accepts only a hash-valid ready CGKNCodexCapabilityBrief with advisory-only authority.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: schema validation, deterministic contract tests, support-pipeline prompt tests, and an offline failed-generation replay

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: The Agent-assisted Provider input and direct-CLI planning contracts are implemented and regression-tested, but the generated child candidate did not pass real pytest under the available local model and exhausted API key.

worked: Bounded Agent guidance reached split leaves and changed the local model output from generic Record scaffolding to the requested Note repository/service/CLI structure.

Compact direct-CLI leaf context and fail-closed ownership checks caught atomic-persistence, ID-generation, service-boundary, CLI-symbol, repair-target, and annotation-safety defects before false delivery.
did_not_work: The 7B local model repeatedly regressed a different file during multi-file repair, and the reviewed API endpoint could not take over because its key usage limit was exceeded.
Static interface checks alone did not prevent all runtime cross-file signature and Python class-annotation failures; real pytest remained essential.
experiments: Add executable cross-interface probes before repair publication and rerun the same sealed brief with a working reviewed Provider or stronger local code model.
